from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ParallelSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.spy_previous_sma_ready = False

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_cross_above = False
        spy_cross_below = False

        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            previous_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady

            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

            if (self.spy_previous_close is not None and
                    previous_sma_ready and
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady):
                spy_cross_above = (
                    self.spy_previous_close <= previous_sma and
                    spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
                spy_cross_below = (
                    self.spy_previous_close >= previous_sma and
                    spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )

            self.spy_previous_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            self.spy_previous_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            if self.aapl_previous_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_bar.Close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if not all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not (self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_cross_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_cross_above:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / float(spy_bar.Close)))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20_000 / float(aapl_bar.Close)))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None

        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            quantity = int(math.floor(0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:

class IndependentDailyStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            self.spy_closes.Add(spy_close)

            if self.spy_closes.IsReady:
                current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0
                self.current_spy_sma = current_sma
            else:
                self.current_spy_sma = None
        else:
            self.current_spy_sma = None

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(self.Time, aapl_bar.Close))

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if not all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            self._StoreSpyHistory()
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self._StoreSpyHistory()
            return

        if (not self.spy_closes.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or
                self.previous_spy_close is None or
                self.previous_spy_sma is None):
            self._StoreSpyHistory()
            return

        spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
        spy_sma = self.current_spy_sma

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma and
            spy_close > spy_sma
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma and
            spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            shares = int(math.floor(
                0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
            ))
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if (self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and
                self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and
                self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000):
            shares = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        self._StoreSpyHistory()

            self.previous_spy_close = float(self.CurrentSlice.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.current_spy_sma

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            self.spy_closes.Add(float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close))

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(self.Time, aapl_close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):

        previous_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

            previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
